visual_description: Since the very start I saw different visual patterns that changed quickly. I didn't know if those would classify as hallucinations, so in the beginning I didn't press space for at least 30s, maybe more. The patterns I saw changed quickly in the beginning, then more and more I started seeing rotating patterns, like a tornado, with the color extending out of the screen a little bit. When I blinked my eyes, the hallucination usually became less prominent, or even disappeared. I could also stop the hallucination without having to blink, if so I wished.   I got a little anxious, thinking if it could trigger some mental health problem, some thoughts about that run through my mind. At some point while that was happening, I started seeing contours that resembled contours of a face.   Later I saw some more localized patterns. I think that mostly at the right part of the screen and probably more at the bottom.   At some point my eyes seemed to get a little dry, so I blinked a lot. I had no hallucinations for a bit. Then I tried to get back to having hallucinations. I started having a little more again, but less pronounced. Eventually I saw some other colors other than black and red. I think I saw white, yellow and orange, for the whole screen.  At the very end I started feeling relaxed. I even wondered if my eyes were closing a little bit. Once in a while, when I was a little more alert I opened my eyes a little more. At those times I had a more "realistic" (less distorted) view of the screen.  When the white screen came with the message saying it was over, it seemed very bright.
duration_visual: Constant, morphing from one image to the next
emotional_experience: No feeling about it one way or the other
consciousness_description: I felt sleepy, a little drowsy. My eyes seemed to be closing, as if I was falling asleep. I had to consciously prevent myself from not falling asleep.
